text:
deploybot: promotion blocked by preflight-evals for release redwood-sum-v2@2026-03-20. Prompt/eval suite 'summarizer-suite' exceeded regression threshold (quality delta +4.3%). See https://dash.redwood/inflight/231111 for details.

Maria P: saw the deploybot alert — what slices are failing? is this global or region-specific?

Kevin L: it looks concentrated on long-summary prompts (>1024 tokens) and the hallucination indicator. NA traffic seems fine; EU samples show higher failure rate.

Priya S: confirmed. Repro steps: use prompt id summ-Long-001, compare v1 vs v2. Failing example: ```Prompt: summarize long doc
V1: factual summary...
V2: adds invented entity XYZ```

Ben R: initial ML triage — likely interaction between the new attention kernel changes and the 4-bit quant path. I can run a quick bisect across quantized builds. Meanwhile we need a decision: pin, rollback, or region-split.

Maria P: product preference is to avoid global rollback if possible. Can we pin EU back to previous stable model and continue controlled rollout in NA?

Kevin L: yes — we can apply a regional pin via routing policy. Plan proposal: 1) pin EU to redwood-sum-v1@stable 2) keep NA canary at 5% for additional telemetry 3) run bisect and a targeted hotfix for quant path 4) update release notes and schedule a change window for an eventual rollback if unresolved.

Priya S: QA approves staged pin and hotfix testing window. I'll validate the failing prompt set after pin. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: We can route EU to the older pool. Need a short maintenance window for routing change (expected 10–15m). Please include x-region-prefer header in requests or update the ALB rule. I can push the route change and monitor.

Kevin L: executing pin command: `/deploybot pin model=redwood-sum-v1@stable --region=eu --reason="preflight regression on summarizer prompt set"`

deploybot: command acknowledged. Pin applied: redwood-sum-v1@stable pinned in region=eu. NA canary preserved at 5% for redwood-sum-v2. Dashboards: https://dash.redwood/traffic/231111 and https://dash.redwood/evals/231111.

Maria P: please add a short release note blurb: "EU: temporarily serving previous summarization model due to preflight regression; NA canary continues. Investigating and will update." Also add rollback contact steps.

Ben R: will push a PR to release-notes repo in a minute and start bisecting quant builds. I'll paste results here.

Kevin L: ops — confirm reserved capacity for rollback if we need global revert? NA traffic pegs if we flip quickly.

ops-oncall: confirmed. Reserved capacity allocated for rollback path. I'll leave alerts on and a pager for 08:00–10:00 UTC tomorrow during the bisect/hotfix window.

Ben R: bisect kickoff: running quant variants q4a,q4b,q8 on sample set. Expect initial results in ~45m. If we can identify a single kernel/variation, we can publish a targeted hotfix.

deploybot: note — automated rollback window scheduled: 2026-03-22T08:00Z if no resolution. To cancel or modify window, reply in this thread with 'cancel rollback' or `/deploybot modify-window 2026-03-22T09:00Z`.

Priya S: I'll run nightly regression sweep and post PASS/FAIL before the scheduled window. If PASS, I'll post 'qa: pass' and ask to cancel rollback.

Maria P: product sign-off for staged-pin + bisect plan. :white_check_mark: Please keep comms here and tag me for final decision.

Kevin L: thanks everyone. I'll follow-up with the exact commands and small runbook:
```
# pin (already applied)
/deploybot pin model=redwood-sum-v1@stable --region=eu --reason="preflight regression"
# to rollback globally
/deploybot rollback release=redwood-sum-v2@2026-03-20 --scope=global --reason="failed preflight"
# to cancel automated rollback
/deploybot comment 2311112222 "cancel rollback"
```

Ben R: bisect results: q4a shows regression on 3 failing prompts, q4b matches v1 on those prompts. Hypothesis: q4a quant path triggers attention rounding issue. Next step: recompile kernels with fallback for long-seq paths and run hotfix canary in NA at 1%.

Priya S: QA will run the hotfix canary tests. If green, post 'qa: pass' and request rollback cancel.

deploybot: hotfix canary deployed to NA 1% as requested. Monitor: https://dash.redwood/canary/231111.

Priya S: qa: pass. Failing prompt set now within thresholds on hotfix canary.

Maria P: cancel rollback — product authorizes continuing rollout after hotfix verification. Maria P approves.

deploybot: automated rollback canceled per thread instruction. Canary to ramp per rollout policy: +10% every 30m until 100% unless new alert.

Kevin L: closing action items: Ben to open patch PR for kernel fallback; Priya to run full regression sweep tomorrow morning; Ops to monitor and hold rollback channel open. Thanks team.

Maria P: thanks all — add this summary to release notes and mark as resolved when PR merges.
